idea-plugin.name: Word Counter
idea-plugin.description:
Word and character counts in the status bar for plain text, Markdown, and MDX.

  • Live totals for the whole document or selected text, including multiple selections.
  • Markdown-aware counting excludes frontmatter, formatting, link URLs, and code blocks.
  • Count literal MDX text without evaluating components or expressions.
  • Click the counter to adjust the update delay and include or exclude whitespace.

Free and open source under the MIT license. Source and documentation | Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0: Initial release.

  • Word and character totals for TXT, Markdown, and MDX.
  • Whole-document, selection, and multiple-caret counts.
  • Configurable update delay and whitespace counting in the status-bar popup.
  • Background counting with a plain-text fast path and compact Markdown source mappings.
